name: 3d7
key_challenge: Extreme AT-bias (~81% AT), subtelomeric var/rifin/stevor repeat families

download.command: datasets download genome accession GCF_000002765.4 --include genome --filename ncbi_dataset.zip && unzip -o ncbi_dataset.zip && cat ncbi_dataset/data/GCF_000002765.4/*.fna > reference.fasta && rm -rf ncbi_dataset ncbi_dataset.zip

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 50 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: AT-bias breaks k-mer seeding assumptions in many aligners. dwgsim default error model may need GC-bias adjustment.

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Partition accuracy by core chromosomal regions vs. subtelomeric var/rifin/stevor families. Multimapping in subtelomeric regions is expected; low MAPQ there is correct behavior. Real data available via MalariaGEN/Pf3k (ENA taxid 36329).
